sobre.title: The Firm | MSPADV — Marcelo Paiva Advocacia
sobre.desc: About MSPADV: 30 years of litigation practice in family law, domestic violence and criminal defense in Brazil, with service in English and Portuguese.
sobre.h1: Three decades of practice in family and criminal law
sobre.lead: A firm devoted to people going through decisive moments — within the family or before the criminal courts — with skill, strategy and a human approach.
sobre.h2: Technical, strategic work with no improvisation
paras: MSPADV — Marcelo Paiva Advocacia focuses on two fields that frequently intersect: family law (divorce, division of assets, custody, support and urgent measures) and criminal defense, with particular emphasis on domestic violence cases.

The firm is led by attorney Marcelo Paiva, who holds a master's degree in Criminal Law and Criminal Sciences and has worked in litigation since 1998, running his own practice since 2003. That experience makes it possible to see the whole case: how a protective order affects custody, how an accusation affects the division of assets, how a lawsuit affects the life of the person facing it.
We serve Brazilian and foreign clients, with fluent communication in English and Portuguese, so that every person fully understands their situation and the strategy adopted.
sobre.cards_title: Where the firm concentrates its experience
cards: Uncontested and contested divorce, division of assets and dissolution of stable unions.
Custody, parenting time and child support, guided by the best interests of the child.
Protective orders and Maria da Penha Law proceedings, handled with skill and balance.
Representation at every stage — investigation, trial, judgment and appeals.
Injunctions, habeas corpus, release requests and urgent family court relief.
Service in English in criminal cases and family matters with an international element.
values: No decision is improvised. Every move is planned.
You understand, in plain language, what is happening and what your options are.
Emergencies do not wait. We are reachable when you need us.
Discretion is an essential part of the work we do for those who come to us.
